title: Design System: MG Holding Employee Portal

display.purpose: The greeting on Home. One per page, regular weight.

headline.purpose: Page and section headings, regular weight.

body.purpose: Running text, capped at 68ch (60ch in Arabic).

label.purpose: Keys above values, table heads, tags and badges.

components.name: Label strip
components.description: The signature. Every record opens with the same ruled strip of its real fields; on hover the closing rule takes the accent and strikes in from the centre.
components.css: .ds-strip { position: relative; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-block-end: 1px solid var(--rule, #e0dad4); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-strip::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-block-end: -1px; inset-inline: 0; block-size: 2px; background: var(--brand-accent-edge, #b4552d); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-strip:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-strip-pair { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding-block: 8px 12px; padding-inline-end: 20px; } .ds-strip-pair + .ds-strip-pair { padding-inline-start: 20px; border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--rule-muted, #eae5e0); } .ds-strip dt { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--text-muted, #51655a); } .ds-strip dd { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-strong, #12291d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-strip:hover dd { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only solid accent in the portal, so it is always the action the visitor is meant to take.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New ticket</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-block-size: 38px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--brand-accent-fill, #b4552d); color: var(--brand-accent-on, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--brand-accent-edge, #b4552d); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-accent-hover, #8e4221); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--brand-accent-wash-2, #f7d8c7); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--brand-accent-active, #733419); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-accent-ink, #933706); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A hairline on the raised surface. The default for everything that is not the one primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-block-size: 38px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--text-strong, #12291d); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #cfc9c2); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f3efea); border-color: var(--brand-accent-edge, #b4552d); color: var(--brand-accent-ink, #933706); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-accent-ink, #933706); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Colour plus a per-status icon silhouette, so the state survives greyscale and direct sun.
components.html: Overdue
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-block-size: 24px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #cfc9c2); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-sunken, #f3efea); color: var(--text-body, #213a2d); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-danger { background: var(--danger-surface, #ffedeb); border-color: var(--danger-edge, #f2c2bc); color: var(--danger-ink, #a04038); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A hairline field on the raised surface. The focus treatment is shared with every other control in the system.
components.css: .ds-input { inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: 38px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--text-strong, #12291d); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #cfc9c2); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; transition: border-color 120ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #aaa49c; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--brand-accent-edge, #b4552d); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-accent-ink, #933706); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--danger-ink, #a04038); background: var(--danger-surface, #ffedeb); }

components.name: Round Arrow Button
components.description: The lime disc in the corner of a card that opens somewhere. Always a link with a name saying where it goes.
components.css: .ds-arrow { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--highlight, #c9f03d); border: 1px solid var(--highlight-edge, #6c8610); color: var(--highlight-on, #12291d); transition: background-color 120ms; } .ds-arrow svg { transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-arrow:hover { background: var(--highlight-hover, #b6de22); } .ds-arrow:hover svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-accent-ink, #8f4023); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: A pill above a card title naming the kind of thing below. Lime only for "new".
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #cfc9c2); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-body, #213a2d); } .ds-tag--new { background: var(--highlight, #c9f03d); border-color: var(--highlight-edge, #6c8610); color: var(--highlight-on, #12291d); }

narrative.northStar: The Assay Card, on a softer desk
narrative.overview:
A mine assays its ore and writes the result on a card: what the sample is, where it came from, what it measured, and who signed for it. That card is still how this portal holds a record. A support ticket, a room booking, a colleague and an announcement each open with the same ruled strip of labelled values, so one reading habit covers the whole product.

What changed is the desk the cards lie on. The surfaces are now soft: generously rounded white sheets on warm off-white paper, with clear air between them, read in a deep pine ink rather than graphite. One fixed lime highlight marks the small things that open something. Home is a bento of these sheets in different sizes under a large rounded welcome banner. The rule that holds the two halves together is **soft outside, measured inside**: the card's corner is 16px, but the strip, the badge and the numerals within it stay as crisp as before.

The shell is still anonymous, because identity belongs to the company. A Company record supplies one accent colour, every brand value is derived from it with contrast guaranteed by arithmetic, and that accent owns primary buttons, links, focus and the current page. Lime is the portal's own and never changes with the company. Work pages (ticket queue, admin, audit log) do not take the soft measure: they run compact, which is the original Assay Card geometry.
keyCharacteristics: Soft outside, measured inside: 16px cards and a 24px banner around hairline-ruled label strips.
Warm off-white paper, deep pine ink, and one fixed lime highlight that only ever carries pine.
One runtime accent per company, every other brand value derived from it and AA-safe for any hue.
Two densities from one token set: comfortable for Home and reading, compact for work.
Large headings set light; bold kept for the small things that must be found fast.
Arabic and English designed together, with identical weight coverage and their own leading.
State is always encoded twice, so nothing depends on colour alone.

rules.name: The Derived Accent Rule
rules.body: A company supplies one value, `--brand-accent`. Fill, hover, active, on-colour, ink, edge and both washes are computed from it in `tokens.css`. Never hand-author a second brand colour or write a literal accent into a component.

rules.name: The Fixed Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime is small and it is a surface, never text and never a large field. It appears only on round arrow buttons, icon discs and the "new" tag, and only pine is ever drawn on it. It does not replace the accent: a primary button is never lime.

rules.name: The Luminance Flip Rule
rules.body: Whether a label on an accent fill is black or white is decided on WCAG relative luminance (threshold Y 0.179), not on OKLCH lightness.

rules.name: The Outward Press Rule
rules.body: Hover and active mix a fill away from its label colour, so pressing a control can only improve its contrast.

rules.name: The Light Large Rule
rules.body: `h1`, `h2` and the display size take the regular weight. Everything from a card title down takes the bold. Weight separates the page's voice from its data, so the two are never confused.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: `tabular-nums lining-nums` is set on `body`. The Arabic subset excludes U+0030–0039, so every digit in both languages comes from the Latin face and lines up identically. Dates and times are formatted with Latin digits in Arabic for the same reason.

rules.name: The Arabic Equal Standing Rule
rules.body: Arabic takes its own leading (1.75) and measure (60ch), never uppercase and never letter-spacing. The label's small-caps treatment is replaced for Arabic by weight and colour at one size up.

rules.name: The Sunlight Floor
rules.body: On a phone a record's title and text step up to 1rem and its keys and badges to 0.75rem. Desktop keeps the dense measure.

rules.name: The Logical Properties Rule
rules.body: `margin-inline`, `padding-block`, `inset-inline-end`, `text-align: start`. Never `left` or `right`. The marked exceptions are the select chevron's background position and `.icon--dir` mirroring.

rules.name: The Declare Once Rule
rules.body: An element gets a border or a shadow, never both.

rules.name: The No Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: No shadow may carry structure. A rounded card does not earn a drop shadow.

dos: **Do** open every record with a label strip carrying its real fields.
**Do** keep the card soft and its contents crisp: 16px outside, hairlines and 4px chips inside.
**Do** read `--radius-control`, `--radius-card` and the other density tokens in components, and set `data-density="compact"` on work pages, tables and record lists.
**Do** draw only `--highlight-on` on lime, in both themes.
**Do** set `h1`, `h2` and the display size in the regular weight, and data in the bold.
**Do** give a card with nothing to show a one-line empty state at its own size.
**Do** encode state twice, give anything tappable 44px on a phone, and use logical properties only.
**Do** give Arabic its own leading and measure, and Latin digits in dates and numbers.
donts: **Don't** nest a card in a card, or frame an empty state inside one.
**Don't** put a shadow on a card, or a border and a shadow on the same element.
**Don't** use lime as text, as a large surface, or in place of the company accent.
**Don't** use a pill for a status or a square chip for a category.
**Don't** use the 16px or 24px radius on a table frame or anything on a work page.
**Don't** show a page-sized empty state on a page that has other content.
**Don't** apply `text-transform: uppercase` or letter-spacing to Arabic.
**Don't** add a second authored motion; the label strip's register is the one.
